title: fix(cli): os i18n extract seeds a field help entry from its description when inlineHelpText is empty
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99xJJWSaMiqsy9A1NjZ6HbD)_
Fixes #29221

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os i18n extract` 为字段 `help` 条目取默认语言原文时，改为取 `help`、`inlineHelpText`、`description` 中第一个真正写了内容的值；空字符串视为没写，与 console 帮助行 `inlineHelpText || description` 的读法一致。
- 为什么改：原来的 `??` 链停在 `inlineHelpText: ''` 上，这类字段的 `help` 条目没有原文，console 实际显示的 description 从未进入翻译包。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 cli 抽取器给 `help` 条目选原文；非空 `inlineHelpText` 仍优先于 description，`help` 仍最优先，全空字段照旧。仓库内没有任何非测试源码写 `inlineHelpText: ''` 或 `help: ''`，已提交的翻译包不变。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` 中 `collectExpectedEntries` 的字段 `help` 那一段；`packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-inline-help-text.test.ts` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n-extract-inline-help-text.test.ts`，应看到 15 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。（卡片的 Edge 2 按派单只做读数、不改代码，见 Acceptance notes。）

## What changes

`collectExpectedEntries` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) seeds a field's `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.help` entry from the **first authored link** of `help`, `inlineHelpText`, `description`, read through `asAuthoredLabel`, the one "authored" test the file already uses (a non-empty string, or a non-empty inline locale map). Before, it read `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description`, which stops at an empty string.

- `inlineHelpText: ''` or `help: ''` beside a `description` now scaffolds the description, which is the line the console draws (`fieldHelpText` in `@object-ui/fields`: `inlineHelpText || description`).
- Unchanged: `help` wins over both; a non-empty `inlineHelpText` wins over `description`; a field whose links are all empty gets the same seed-less entry as before.
- Whitespace-only text stays authored. That matches the console's `||` (a single space is truthy, so it is the line drawn) and the resolver's non-empty check in PR #29217. Skipping it here would make the extractor disagree with both.
- Changeset: `.changeset/29221-i18n-extract-field-help-empty-link.md`, a `patch` for `@objectstack/cli`.

The `os i18n check` coverage gate reads the same entries, so a field with `inlineHelpText: ''` and a `description` no longer reports its default locale as missing `help`.

## Tests

New `describe` in `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-inline-help-text.test.ts` (9 tests, beside the existing order pins):

- `inlineHelpText: ''` with `description: 'B'` seeds `help` = `'B'`; `help: ''` likewise; `help: ''` with an `inlineHelpText` seeds the `inlineHelpText`;
- a non-empty `inlineHelpText` still wins over `description`; `help` still wins over both (with and without an empty `inlineHelpText`);
- whitespace-only `inlineHelpText` stays the source, and the restated console reader draws it too;
- every link empty still emits the seed-less entry;
- for five field shapes that author no `help`, the seed equals the line the console draws (`inlineHelpText || description`, restated);
- `computeI18nCoverage` counts the default locale as covered when the seed is the description behind an empty `inlineHelpText`.

No forced edits to existing tests.

## Acceptance notes

- **One rule, every site (Edge 1, measured).** The field `help` entry is the only place in the extractor that derives help text through a fallback chain. The other help keys each read one key with no fallback: flow screen fields' `inlineHelpText` (the screen field schema has no `description`), form section entries' `helpText`, action params' `helpText`, bulk params' `help`, metadata-form fields' `helpText`. Each already goes through `asAuthoredLabel` or `pushOptional`, so an empty string authors no entry there. `i18n-coverage.ts` has no derivation of its own.
- **Committed bundles (measured).** No non-test source in the repo authors `inlineHelpText: ''` or `help: ''` (`git grep` hits only CHANGELOG prose and the `@object-ui/fields` README/docblock). `check:i18n` (the nine generated bundle packages) and `check:i18n-coverage` are in the gate run below; nothing was regenerated.
- **Edge 2 (reading, no code).** A field authoring both a non-empty `inlineHelpText` and a different `description` gets one `help` entry, seeded from the `inlineHelpText`, and the resolver serves its translation on `description` too. Readers of a field's `description` besides the console's help line, read on this head:
  - Studio designer surfaces: the field inspector's description box (`ObjectFieldInspector`), the form canvas preview (`ObjectFormCanvas`), the data-model designer's row tooltip (`DataModelDesigner.fieldTooltip`), the property editor (`plugin-designer` `PropertyEditor`), and `MetadataService.toFieldPayload`, which writes `description` back on save.
  - `RecordDetailPanel` copies `description` onto each detail field; no renderer in `plugin-detail` draws a field's `description` (grep on this head).
  - The runtime's action summary for the MCP tool list (`summarizeActionParams`) uses a backing field's `description` as a param's help when the param has no `helpText`. It reads the registry's object, not a localized serve (traced to the MCP domain's declarations loop; not traced end to end).
  - A separate `description` entry from the extractor would need a bundle key that `FieldTranslationSchema` does not declare, which is a `packages/spec` change. The fix that needs no new key is in the resolver (`translateObject`): serve the `help` entry on `description` only when the field authors no non-empty `inlineHelpText`. That is spec seat 1's surface and reverses what the #29153 ruling kept, so it is reported to the seat, not done here.

## Verification

Head `3298a9c9`, the merge of `origin/main` at `01252a45`. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` on `a6ea00b0` (the commit before the merge): Test Files 372 passed (372), Tests 5259 passed (5259); typecheck and `check:test-typecheck` OK. VERDICT command-exit 0. The `integration` tier is CI's (no integration-tier file or spawn entry touched).
- After merging `origin/main` (it touched no cli file; it touched `packages/spec` and `service-analytics`, both rebuilt): the two extractor files, Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 39 passed (39). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched cli files (the root `pnpm lint` command, scoped): exit 0, no output.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the old chain turns the new pins red</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description` back over the new chain (anchor 1 to 0, blob `21178839abf6` to `1ccf82f67d58`), ran the test file through the lock and restored (`git diff HEAD` empty after). The test imports the extractor from `src`, so no build was involved.

- Tests 5 failed, 10 passed (15). The five: `inlineHelpText: ''` beside a description, `help: ''` beside a description, `help: ''` beside an `inlineHelpText` (each `expected undefined to be 'B'` or `'I'`), the console-agreement matrix (`expected undefined to be 'B'`), and the coverage case (`expected [ { severity: 'error', … } ] to deeply equal []`).
- The pins that stay green under the ablation are the preservation pins (`help` wins, non-empty `inlineHelpText` wins, whitespace stays, all-empty is seed-less): they hold before and after, as intended.

</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `3298a9c9`: 61 commands (the same list as on `a6ea00b0`, before the merge). Each ran with stdin closed; 58 exited 0 on the first pass.
- Three exited 3 (prerequisite, not a finding) and pass on a rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='./examples/**'` (VERDICT command-exit 0). `check:i18n-coverage`: "OK (14 config(s), 426 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)"; `check:i18n` exit 0. The working tree stayed clean: nothing was regenerated.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` (each line carrying its exit code): "61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 61 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Exit 0.
- Not measured locally: the CI-only families and scheduled jobs `--commands` does not list. Those are CI's readings.

</details>
